_note: Shofi, the in-game sales app (D-123, D-128). It shows orders, sales and the courier pickup. There is no listing step, no price setting and no shop search: every order comes from a video, and a product the player has in stock sells at its usual price. Courier (D-113): one pickup window a day. Book before the cutoff for today's window, otherwise it is tomorrow's. The courier comes at some time inside the window and waits waitMin minutes at the door; you hand over packed parcels there. Orders not handed over by shipByMin after they came are cancelled. Reviews are shown only; they change nothing. Times are minutes after midnight.
